source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (API 0.6 map call, Nov 1 2026), filtered to the club: the 18 hole ways (pars agree with golfcourseapi's card on all 18; the stroke index is the card's, OSM has none here), the 18 greens the lines end in, tee boxes, bunkers, fairways (OSM's multipolygons with their bunkers and islands cut out), ponds and the marked water hazards within 100 m of a hole line, woods within 120 m, the club outline as the boundary. Made by scripts/callahan/convert.py.
source.lineStarts: Holes 4, 9 and 13: OSM's line started at a forward tee (the White, the Member and the Blue box: 474, 284 and 383 yds to the green along the line against the card's Black 534, 398 and 415), with the Black box 50-117 yds behind it; the line is extended back to that box's centre (q osm+tee), which measures 533, 401 and 436 yds to the green via the old start. Hole 6: OSM drew the line from hole 4's Black pad (holes 4 and 6 tee off one complex; 191 yds to 6's green against the card's 156), so the line now starts at 6's own Black box (157; the card and Tangent's Black marker agree). Hole 1 has no Black box of its own: the back pad measures 470 (card Blue 461 / Black 495), so Black and Blue share it. Tangent's Black marker on 13 sits on the Blue box (367 yds); the card's 415 is the box behind, kept. Not field-checked.
source.caveat: Not traced by hand: as accurate as OSM. McCanless, Sardis and Byrd Creeks and their feeders are OSM waterway centrelines buffered 3.5 m each side (q osm+buffer, as at Creekside), so a ball read as water is a ball within ~4 m of the mapped centreline; a wider pool reads rough. Not field-checked.
source.woods: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud (GA_Statewide_B2_2018, s3://usgs-lidar-public): every 1 m cell whose highest return stands 3 m or more above the bare earth and holds high-vegetation points, within 75 m of a hole line, off the mapped turf, bunkers and water (scripts/lidar-trees/, D133).

imagery.release: Cherokee County's 6-inch orthophoto (winter, bare trees; the county's 2025 flight by its Aerial2025 service), Cherokee County GIS's public image service, one 512-px export per 256-px tile, as at Woodmont and Bradshaw (D140). No licence stated.

imageryEsri.release: World Imagery Wayback 2026-10-29 (release 43291): the current leaf-on capture (every release from Feb 2026 on is the same one, sharp, dormant fairways); the Oct 2025-Jan 2026 releases are a greener but softer capture

elevation.source: USGS 3DEP (elevation.nationalmap.gov 3DEPElevation ImageServer getSamples, bilinear; 1 m lidar where flown), via scripts/fetch-3dep.mjs

greenGrids.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (elevation.nationalmap.gov ImageServer getSamples, bilinear), via scripts/fetch-green-slopes.mjs
